senses.gloss: thutthu (-kārakam, adv.), (making) the sound thutthu (in eating): na … Mvy 〔8579〕 = Tib. hu hu (the sound of oneʼs mouth in eating) mi bya. Cf. Skt. Lex. thū-thū, said to be imitative of spitting; Skt. thūtkāra, and the like. Chin. onomat., indicating that one has eaten something hot.
